fact: As at June 2020, GIZ states that a digitised system for processing and transmitting information on investigations, criminal proceedings, arrest warrants, fines and sanctions is barely used in Cameroon's police (DGSN), owing to weak institutional capacity and unreliable internet, electricity and IT equipment; the German Foreign Office-funded programme under the DGSN runs July 2019 to December 2022 on about EUR 2.77 million and names use of the national digitised crime database as a priority.
title: Appui à la police camerounaise
publisher: Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH
